hostPlayerId.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

hostPublicKey.description: Clients verify every TURN_GRANT against this key.

playerId.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key, 32 raw bytes, base64.

rig.description: The player's declared rig, for provenance (ArcAid badge, never a gate).

participants.description: Everyone accepted so far, in join order.

hostGame.description: The host's fingerprint, so a client the host accepted despite a difference (advisory mode) can show it too. null from a host that does not send it.

tableName.description: Human name of the table or ROM set.

tableHash.description: SHA-256 of the ORIGINAL .vpx (never the patched copy), or of the arcade ROM zip.

romName.description: PinMAME ROM set name (e.g. mm_109c) or arcade ROM name; null for originals.

romHash.description: SHA-256 of the ROM zip; null for originals.

physicsHash.description: Hash of the physics-relevant table settings; null when not computed.

recipeVersion.description: Castcade patch recipe version applied to this table (ADR 0004); null for arcade.

sidecarHash.description: SHA-256 of the generated sidecar .vbs; proves both players run the same patch.

emulatorVersion.description: VPX or RetroArch core version string.

anyOf.description: Everything that must match between participants for a fair match. The host compares these at HELLO.

tableMismatches.description: A8 (2026-10-31): every accepted participant whose fingerprint differs from the host's (advisory mode), with what differs, so each client can flag the others too, not only itself. Additive and defaulted, so still protocol 2: a host that does not send it reads as no differences. Not in MATCH_READY: that message is logged, and a peer that strips or defaults an unknown field would hash a different log.

playerId.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

expectedFrom.description: Which participant the host compared against.

startsInMs.description: The host starts the match in this many ms (its first game on the table, A11); null when no start is under way. A duration, not a time: the two clocks need not agree.

loading.description: Accepted participants whose table is not open yet, as the host judges from their fingerprint (A11): the match does not start from the table until this is empty.

items.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

ballEndReady.description: A13: what each participant (the host included) said about its table's ball ends (`HELLO.ballEndReady`, then `PARTICIPANT_UPDATE.ballEndReady`): `ready` false = that player's table cannot report ball ends, so its turn would never end by itself. A participant not listed is unknown. Defaulted and never logged.

playerId.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

description: host -> client. The HELLO was accepted; the match is not ready until MATCH_READY. Sent again to every client while in the lobby when a PARTICIPANT_UPDATE (or the host itself) changed the roster or the host fingerprint.
